summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of the full KJAPP trip pipeline (customer <-> real driver). All requested steps PASSED: (1) Onboarding 'Kom i gang' -> login-demo-fill + login-submit -> home. (2) Tapping quick-Jobb rendered route review with vehicle-ai-first, booking-payment-row and booking-confirm. (3) booking-confirm fired POST /api/trips/request -> 200 with trip_id b0aa447e-68d9-43bc-976b-6b468578e03d and app navigated to /booking/{tripId} where customer-trip-status = 'Søker sjåfør' and booking-map rendered. (4) Driver flow via curl (sjafor@kjapp.no): /auth/login -> token, /driver/online true, /driver/location, /driver/pending returned the just-created trip, /driver/accept -> 200; two follow-up /driver/location calls simulated movement. Within the first 2.5s poll the customer screen updated to 'Sjåfør på vei' and driver card showed 'Ola Sjåfør', 'Tesla Model Y', plate 'EL12345', rating 4.9. (5) /driver/trip/{id}/at-pickup, /start (customer saw 'Turen pågår'), /arrive all returned {ok:true}; booking screen auto-navigated to /receipt/{tripId} which displays price 183 kr, driver info and rate-star-1..5. rate-star-3 tap -> POST /api/trips/{id}/rate 200; receipt-done -> /home. (6) Realness check confirmed: POST /api/cars/nearby with driver OFFLINE returned count=0, cars=[]; with driver ONLINE at (59.917,10.752) returned count=1 with the real driver record (id 6aa317e419345d38e257c489, Ola Sjåfør, Tesla Model Y, EL12345, rating 4.9). No fake/simulated cars observed. Deprecated RN warning still present: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (from previous iteration).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/home.tsx around lines 426-428 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/app/(app)/home.tsx (confirm button) and any other occurrences to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
Optional polish: receipt.tsx renders 'Kjøretøy: KJAPP' for vehicle_type 'ai-first' (vehicleMeta fallback). Not blocking, just a label refinement.
critical_code_review_comments: booking/[tripId].tsx polls /api/trips/{id} every 2.5s -- fine for preview but consider websocket/SSE and exponential backoff for production battery/network usage.
receipt/[tripId].tsx does a single GET on mount without retry/loading-error state; if the first call fails the screen shows the loader indefinitely. Consider adding a retry or error UI.
